seoTitle: Metro Nashville Public Schools Calendar | MNPS
seoDescription: Metro Nashville Public Schools calendar dates, grade-specific half days, breaks, stockpiled days, official PDFs, translations, and ICS downloads.
districtFact: MNPS publishes one district calendar with attendance rules that change by grade: Pre-K and kindergarten have half-day opening schedules, grades 9–12 have exam half days while Pre-K–8 remain in school all day, and the final day is a half day for everyone.

about.title: The Opening Schedule Changes by Grade
about.content: MNPS opens with full days for grades 1–12 and half days for Pre-K and kindergarten. Families should read the grade scope rather than treating the first date as the same schedule for every student.

about.title: High-School Exam Half Days Are Not Districtwide Half Days
about.content: On designated exam dates, grades 9–12 attend for half a day while Pre-K–8 attend for a full day. The semester-ending date and last student day are separate half days for all students.

about.title: Student Breaks and Office Closures Are Different
about.content: The Thanksgiving and Winter student breaks are longer than the periods when district offices are closed. This distinction matters when families need district services during a student holiday.

about.title: Official Calendars Are Published in Seven Languages
about.content: For 2026–27, MNPS provides the English calendar plus Arabic, Burmese, Kurdish, Somali, Spanish, and Swahili editions. These are language versions of the same district schedule, not separate attendance tracks.

calendarNotes: Use the annual MNPS PDF for the adopted student schedule and the live district calendar for current events and later additions. Opening and exam-day attendance differs by grade. A district-closed label describes district operations and may cover fewer days than a student break. Stockpiled professional-development and inclement-weather days are planning categories; a potential make-up date is not a confirmed student day unless MNPS activates it. Official translated PDFs are language editions of the same schedule. A MySchoolDates ICS file is a one-time import and does not update automatically.

districtFaqs.q: Do all MNPS students follow the same schedule on the first days of school?
districtFaqs.a: No. Grades 1–12 attend full days on the published opening dates, while Pre-K and kindergarten attend half days. Use the school-year page for the exact dates.

districtFaqs.q: Are MNPS high-school exam half days also half days for younger students?
districtFaqs.a: No. On dates labeled for grades 9–12 exams, Pre-K–8 attend a full day. Dates labeled as half days for all students apply districtwide.

districtFaqs.q: Is the MNPS district closed for every day of Thanksgiving or Winter Break?
districtFaqs.a: Not necessarily. The annual calendar lists the full student break and separately identifies the dates when district offices are closed.

districtFaqs.q: Does MNPS publish translated school calendars?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. The 2026–27 district calendar is available in English, Arabic, Burmese, Kurdish, Somali, Spanish, and Swahili. They are official language editions of the same calendar.

districtFaqs.q: Are potential snow make-up dates confirmed school days?
districtFaqs.a: No. They are contingency dates. Families should wait for an MNPS announcement before treating any potential make-up date as a required student day.
